title: South LA’s Vibrant Latino Carnaval
description:
South Los Angeles came as neighbors gathered to celebrate culture, history, and community at the District 9 Latino Carnival. Hosted by Councilman Curren Price for Latino Heritage Month, the outdoor festival brought families together across generations.

The festival grounds came alive with music, hands-on booths, youth games, and local craft vendors. Food lovers enjoyed an exciting mix of dishes, lining up for classic Mexican and Salvadoran specialties alongside trendy birria ramen. Families explored vibrant art displays and danced to upbeat tunes while connecting with neighbors and supporting local businesses.

By highlighting local heritage and talent, the carnival offered far more than simple fun. It built lasting neighborhood pride and created meaningful memories for South LA families.
